pages.title: Xenobot Swarm
pages.text: Living machines a millimetre across, built from cells arranged in shapes no animal ever had. They walk, push, heal and even assemble copies of themselves from loose cells. They twitch in the jar, busy.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Xenobots were real: frog cells arranged by an evolutionary algorithm. I gave a general AI core stem cells and nanites to design with, and the Bioreactor built whatever shape it picked. Some of them built more of themselves.
